notes: Accessed entirely via Claude-in-Chrome (own tab). robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow (generic Shopify robots.txt); proceeded. Lakeland is a UK kitchenware/homeware specialist on Shopify with NO dedicated 'Furniture' top-level nav department (confirmed departments: Cooking, Baking, Dining & Entertaining, Storage & Organisation, Make Your Own, Electricals, Cleaning, Laundry, Homeware, Food & Drink, Outdoor & Garden, New In). Tree source: fetched /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap_collections_1.xml (602 collection URLs, same-origin fetch via javascript_tool) and keyword-scanned all 602 handles against 25 furniture-signal terms (furnitur/sofa/chair/table/bed/desk/cabinet/wardrobe/stool/bench/dresser/shelv/bookcase/seating/nightstand/armchair/sideboard/trolley/step/ottoman/rack/shelf/unit/drawer/vanity) -> 38 candidate collections, each opened/checked via products.json title+product_type enumeration (full enumeration, not the products_count field). Genuine furniture found in only 2 of the 38 candidates: 'garden-furniture' (under Outdoor & Garden) and 'kitchen-trolleys' (under Storage & Organisation); all other 36 were kitchen racks/liners/organisers/tableware/textiles/utility carts/homonym false-positives (see exclusion list below) with zero furniture-typed products. No rendered 'N products' header text was present in the SSR HTML on either kept collection (grid renders client-side), so per Rule 3 (structured/enumeration) each qty is a full products.json enumeration total, then reduced by title-level exclusion of clearly non-furniture SKUs within that same collection (mirrors the prior Home-Decor pass's 'drop, don't pad' method on this exact site, which cross-validated products.json enumeration as ground truth for Lakeland). Excluded candidate collections and why: furniture-protection & furniture-pads (furniture covers/protectors = care/parts); chopping-boards-racks, kitchen-racks-stands, kitchen-drawer-organisers, fridge-freezer-boxes-shelves, cooling-racks, dish-racks, drawer-shelf-liners, drawer-organisers, spice-racks-containers, shower-basket-shelves, kitchen-hooks-racks, pan-racks-shelves, chopping-board-racks, oven-shelf-liners, shelf-organisers (kitchen racks/organisers/liners, not furniture); tableware, disposable-tableware, outdoor-tableware, table-decorations, tablecloths-table-runners (tableware/textile/decor, not furniture); shopping-bags-trolleys (granny shopping trolleys); garden-furniture-accessories (2 covers + 1 wind pole = care/parts, not furniture itself); vanity-storage (2 products: hanging handbag organiser + utility storage container = standalone storage, not a vanity unit); shoe-racks-boxes (24 products, all plastic/fabric/steel racks, boxes, under-bed storage and boot bags -- no furniture-grade shoe cabinet present -- standalone storage, excluded in full); steps-stools (6 folding utility step-stools for reaching, not seating stools -- matches prior Home-Decor pass's exclusion of this same collection); wheeled-storage-units (6 'NeatNest' ironing/cleaning/laundry trolleys -- utility equipment, not furniture); sparklers-crackers-poppers, christmas-crackers, crackers, nutcrackers, vegetable-brushes, bed-bug-treatment (keyword false-positives from 'crack/nut/brush/bed' substrings, unrelated to furniture). Sanity checks: confirmed h1/breadcrumb on each opened collection matched the requested node; confirmed garden-furniture and kitchen-trolleys product_type fields tie to their own collection name (not a parent/site-wide figure); products.json limit=250 returned fewer than 250 items in both kept collections, proving the enumeration reached the true end (no pagination needed).

rows.evidence: products.json enumeration of /collections/garden-furniture (limit=250) returned 21 products, all product_type='Garden Furniture'; excluded 1 title-level non-furniture SKU ('Everdure Pizza Making Station', a cooking appliance) => 20 furniture items retained: 13 Lafuma camping/deck/reclining chairs, 2 Lafuma sunbeds, 2 Lafuma balcony furniture sets, and 4 Cozze stainless-steel outdoor-kitchen storage cabinet units (2-door/3-door/corner/2-door-with-sink). No rendered listing-header count exists in the SSR HTML (client-rendered grid), so full JSON enumeration was used per Rule 3.
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: the 4 'Cozze Outdoor Kitchen Unit' items are stainless-steel storage cabinets built to house a grill/pizza-oven insert (framed as outdoor-kitchen equipment on-site, one variant includes a sink); counted as furniture (storage cabinet) per the Cabinets/storage-furniture rule, but could reasonably be reclassified as kitchen equipment on review.

rows.evidence: products.json enumeration of /collections/kitchen-trolleys (limit=250) returned 18 products; excluded 3 title-level non-furniture-grade utility items ('Chubby Mesh Cart 3 Tier Vegetable Kitchen Storage Trolley', 'Lakeland Collapsible Storage Trolley', '3-Tier Kitchen Trolley Cream' -- wire-mesh/tiered utility carts) => 15 remaining are all solid-beechwood 'Eddingtons Lambourn/Littlecote/Marlborough/Leverton' trolleys with drawers and a worktop (beech or stainless-steel top), judged furniture-grade (small kitchen cart/sideboard-equivalent). No rendered listing-header count exists in the SSR HTML, so full JSON enumeration was used per Rule 3.
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: 'kitchen trolley' vs. 'storage cart' is a judgement call -- included only the solid-wood drawer trolleys as furniture-grade, excluded the plain wire/tiered utility carts in the same collection; confirm this split against project policy.
